notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 federation-execution lifecycle foundation to the official C++ RTIambassador declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. The embedded development profile prevalidates the composed FOM/MIM and selected logical-time implementation before publishing a federation definition, preserves connection and membership boundaries, and supports named/unnamed joins with additional FOM modules. The linked Catch2 scenarios cover representative success and failure paths, not every declared exception or distributed lifecycle race. MIM extension interoperability, remote transport, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, and conformance remain outside this contract.
